title: 第十八章：哼！我在不跟你玩了（下）
content_zh:
这时站在周围只想看个热闹的人也大多屏气凝神；有些人还不可自抑的发出了一声声的惊呼；还有些人双拳紧握，咬牙挺胸，仿佛即将迎接这一击的就是自己一般；甚至还有的胆小些的，都歪着头咧着嘴闭着眼，不忍再看下去，但实在又不甘放过这即将决定胜负的最后一击，于是又慢慢的回了一点头，眯、眯的将眼睛打开了一条缝儿。

    终于，像是电影大荧屏上演出来的那样，最精彩、最激动人心的时刻总是会留个人们各种各样的悬念与疑惑，人们都还没看清楚两人到底怎么碰撞在一起的，就看到了两道人影在地上一前一后翻滚起来，一直翻了好几圈，才慢慢地停住了身子，但是两人却是谁也没有起来，若不是在场的众人看到这两人不断起伏的胸口，证明他们确实还活着，恐怕就要一拥而上将他们抬到场外了。

    这也是贺峰最头疼的一个规矩，在双方挑战时，哪怕是晕过去，只要还有醒过来，继续战斗的能力，就不会有人理你，直到你需要急救，才会把你抬到场外，被动的退出比赛，这让一直想要装晕的贺峰不知腹诽了多少遍这个坑人的规矩。

    呼，这次是彻底的筋疲力尽了啊，真是一根手指头都动不了了，贺峰大喘了口气，心中这样想着，扭过头，再看金灿，发现他也是一点也动不了了，心中才算是彻底的松了口气，想了想，又不禁笑了起来，什么时候，自己也开始想这些小孩子一样，老是想着计较这些有的没的了？

    仿佛听到了贺峰的笑声一般，金灿扭过头看着躺在地上一动不动的贺峰，才大呼了一口气，然后费了好大劲终于换了个更舒服的姿势，继续躺着，他才懒得理贺峰是不是突然发疯了呢。

    一直站在一旁的韵儿狠狠的揉了揉眼睛，像是发现了新大陆一样，惊讶的问道：“赵叔叔，那个黑马小子不会是被撞的傻了吧？我怎么还看到他在笑呢？”

    那位穿着学生素袍的赵叔叔也满是茫然的看了看前方的贺峰，摇了摇头道：“不知道，不过看来应该是想到了什么开心的事才对。”

    “呀，赵叔叔也不知道啊，那他是想起了什么事，那么开心，都被人揍成那样子了，还有心思笑？”韵儿依然天真的问着身边的赵叔叔，不过这次他的赵叔叔并没有回答他的问题，而是嘴角微扬，像是发现了什么好玩的事情一般，将目光转向了另一个人身上。

    李纯这时也是咬着牙撑起了身子，可能是因为身体太胖，也可能是因为身上着实太疼，撑到一半又猛地一下摔了下去，试了两三次，才终于掌握住平衡，不过他的选择和贺峰的却不一样。

    只见李纯咬着牙瞪着眼，摇摇晃晃的来到了已经坐起身来的云鸿飞的身前，瓮声瓮气的说了声：“你可别认输，你打我二弟那一下我看的清清楚楚，我也想在你肚子上坐一下，看看效果怎么样，你放心，我其实也不是很重，应该坐不死人的，不过，这种事儿，我也说不太好，还是看你运气吧，死了也别怨我，只能怪你自己运气不好，安心上路吧。”李纯刚说完，就转过身，想要一屁股坐下去。

    可以说，现在剩下的四个人当中，只有李纯受的伤是最轻的，而受伤最重的却是只放过一次大招的云鸿飞，贺峰和金灿算是半斤对八两，到现在，两个人算是彻底的起不来了。

    “不要，我认输，我退出”云鸿飞的声音还是有些虚弱，以他现在的模样，莫说让李纯那个大胖子一屁股坐下来，就算是随便踢他一脚，也不是现在的他能吃得消的。

    才刚转过去身子的李纯，又慢悠悠的将身子转了过来，说道：“什么？认输？可惜了，不过，咱也是懂规矩的人，既然你认输了，也就不难为你了，赶紧回家吃饭去吧，耽误了睡觉，那损失可就大了。”

    李纯身子又是一扭，像一个刚打了胜仗的将军一样，一步三摇的向着金灿走来，谁知刚走了几步，就听到金灿有些懒洋洋的声音：“我也认输了，你们赢了，不用过来了”。就像是一个刚睡醒就发现有人送来了洗漱用品时，说了句：“你们放着吧，等下我自己来就行了”一般。

    既然胜负已定，剩下的当然就是像那个素袍书生说的那般，几位裁判开始忙活着抬众人回家。
content_en:
At this time, most of the people standing around who just wanted to watch the excitement were holding their breath; some couldn't help but let out a loud exclamation; others clenched their fists, gritted their teeth and raised their chests, as if they were about to receive the blow; some were even more timid, tilting their heads and grinning with their eyes closed, unable to bear to watch anymore, but they were really unwilling to let go of the final blow that was about to determine the outcome, so they slowly nodded back and squinted their eyes open a crack.

Finally, just like what was shown on the big screen in a movie, the most exciting and exciting moments always leave people with all kinds of suspense and doubts. Before people could see clearly how the two people collided, they saw two figures on the ground one after another.They rolled over and rolled several times before slowly stopping, but neither of them got up. If everyone present had not seen the rising and falling chests of these two people, proving that they were indeed still alive, they would have swarmed up and carried them out of the field.

This is also the most troublesome rule for He Feng. When the two sides challenge, even if you faint, as long as you still wake up and continue fighting, no one will care about you. Until you need first aid, you will be carried outside the field and passively withdraw from the game. This makes He Feng, who has always wanted to pretend to be faint, cursed this deceptive rule countless times.

Huh, I am completely exhausted this time. I really can't move a finger. He Feng took a big breath and thought in his heart. He turned his head and looked at Jin Can again. He found that he couldn't move at all. He was completely relieved. After thinking about it, he couldn't help laughing. When did he start to think like these children, always thinking about whether they have something or not?

As if hearing He Feng's laughter, Jin Can turned his head and looked at He Feng, who was lying motionless on the ground, and then took a big breath. Then with great effort, he finally changed to a more comfortable position and continued to lie down. He didn't bother to care whether He Feng had suddenly gone crazy.

Yun'er, who had been standing aside, rubbed her eyes fiercely, as if she had discovered a new world, and asked in surprise: "Uncle Zhao, couldn't that dark horse boy be knocked stupid? Why do I still see him smiling?"

Uncle Zhao, who was wearing a student's plain robe, looked at He Feng in front of him blankly, shook his head and said, "I don't know, but it seems that he must have thought of something happy."

"Yeah, Uncle Zhao doesn't know. Then what did he remember? He was so happy, and even after being beaten like that, he still has the heart to laugh?" Yun'er still innocently asked Uncle Zhao next to him, but this time his Uncle Zhao did not answer his question, but raised the corner of his mouth slightly, as if he had discovered something interesting, and turned his gaze to another person.

At this time, Li Chun gritted his teeth and pushed himself up. Maybe it was because he was too fat, or maybe because his body was in too much pain. He suddenly fell down halfway, and it took him two or three tries before he finally got his balance. However, his choice was different from He Feng's.

I saw Li Chun gritting his teeth and staring, staggering to Yun Hongfei who had already sat up, and said angrily: "Don't give up, I saw clearly when you hit my second brother, I also want to sit on your belly to see the effect, you let go"My heart, I'm actually not very heavy, so I shouldn't be able to kill anyone. However, I don't think it's a good idea to do this. It depends on your luck. If you die, don't blame me. You can only blame yourself for your bad luck. Just go on your way."After Li Chung finished speaking, he turned around and wanted to sit down.

It can be said that among the four remaining people, only Li Chun was the least injured, while the most seriously injured was Yun Hongfei, who only missed one big move. He Feng and Jin Can were evenly matched. As of now, the two of them are completely unable to get up.

"No, I give up, I quit." Yun Hongfei's voice was still a little weak. With his current appearance, not to mention letting the fat man Li Chun sit down, even if he kicked him casually, he couldn't bear it now.

Li Chun, who had just turned around, slowly turned around again and said, "What? Give up? It's a pity. However, we are also people who understand the rules. Since you have given up, it will not be difficult for you. Go home and eat quickly. If you delay your sleep, the loss will be great."

Li Chun twisted his body again, like a general who had just won a battle, and walked toward Jin Can with three unsteady steps. Unexpectedly, after taking a few steps, he heard Jin Can's laziest voice: "I also admit defeat. You won, so there is no need to come over."It's like a person who just woke up and found that someone had brought toiletries, and said: "Just leave it, I will come by myself later."

Now that the outcome was decided, all that was left was, as the scholar in plain robes said, several referees began to get busy carrying everyone home.
